info.title: Gurukul Capstone shop server
info.description: The grocery-shop backend every Gurukul Capstone learner's own front end connects to while they build (D-500), and the superset contract their own backend implements for the capabilities they chose (docs/business-analysis/gurukul-capstone/shop-server.md). Each learner has a data space of their own. Send your shop key on every call as `X-Shop-Key: gkshop_…`; staff routes also need `Authorization: Bearer gkst_…` from `POST /staff/sessions`. Browsers may call it from http://localhost:<port> and http://127.0.0.1:<port>, and your finished shop from its own hosted address. A hosted shop sends its PUBLIC key (`X-Shop-Key: gkpub_…`, from the site's /gurukul-shop.json): customer routes only — staff and /dev routes answer 403 shop.public_key. A hosted shop starts each visit with POST /public/visits (public key only; at most 10 visits a day per site, then 429 site.daily_limit) and sends the visitToken it returns as `X-Shop-Visit` on every other call (401 site.visit_required without it). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`. Limits: 120 requests/minute per key (the tracking lookup 10/minute per key and IP); 500 products, 200 orders a day; 5,000 stock movements kept; orders, movements and receipts older than 60 days are deleted. Money is integer minor units. Add-on routes (shop-server.md, "Add-ons") answer 404 capability.not_chosen unless you chose that add-on on your Product Owner stage. The payment page (`paymentUrl`) is a simulated hosted page: open it with `?returnUrl=http://localhost:<port>/…`; it posts `result=paid|failed` back to itself and returns to `returnUrl?orderNumber=…&result=paid|failed`. Never trust `result`: read GET /orders/{orderNumber}.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A GUID unique per order. The same key again returns the same order (200), never a second one.

staffToken.description: A staff session from POST /staff/sessions (8 hours). Staff routes need it as well as the shop key.

customerToken.description: A shop customer's session from POST /customers/sessions (7 days) — the add-ons customer-accounts, ask-unavailable-item and favourites-reorder. Customer routes need it as well as the shop key.
